source_locator.arabic: وَقَدِ اسْتَدَلَّ بِهِ كَثِيرٌ مِنَ الْقُرَّاءِ عَلَى أَنَّ هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ مَدَنِيَّةٌ،

links.semantic_link_note: Supports only the inference attributed to many Quran readers (unnamed). Anonymous group label and scope are retained in the proposition statement; this is not Anas's speech or a claim of independent historical verification.

propositions.statement_en: Ibn Kathir reports that many Quran readers inferred from the preceding report that this surah is Medinan.
Ibn Kathir reports that many jurists inferred from the preceding report that the basmala is part of the surah and was revealed with it.

clause_scope_contract.controlled_translation: Many Quran readers have inferred from it that this surah is Medinan.

clause_scope_contract.controlled_translation: And many jurists [have inferred from it] that the basmala is part of the surah and was revealed with it.
